ARCS kitAtom 38wordmark

Wordmark

Sign a surface as ARCS Field OS in one line of mono type that scales with whatever size its context sets.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1ARCSMono, extra bold, tracked 0.22em, uppercasecyan
2Field OSMono, regular, tracked 0.14em, uppercasetext-secondary
3Gap0.45em, baseline aligned; the size comes from the parentnone

Usage

Use it when

  • A page or a video frame needs the ARCS Field OS signature.
  • The surface inlines or links the kit tokens.

Do not use it when

  • The surface names a product line instead (ARCS · 12D ORBITAL style headers); those are a different lockup.
  • A counterpart page where the ARCS brand would distract from the ask; the Brooks one-pager signs with a name only.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
nonefixed textnoThe words are fixed; set font-size on the parent or a context rule.

Access

  • aria-label="ARCS Field OS" on the element so it reads as one name, not two words spelled by letter.
  • Colour is decoration only; the words carry the name.
  • Not interactive.
